Right now I keep bookmarks in my browser and it's a mess — I save a link and then can never find it again. So a few things would make my life easier:

- I want to just paste a web address and have it saved, and ideally the app grabs the page's title and a bit of description automatically so I don't have to type it all in.
- I want to organize them with tags, and be able to click a tag to see just those.
- I really want good search — searching by words in the title or description, and by tag — so I can actually find things later.
- A "read later" pile would help, so I can mark stuff to come back to and see just those.
- I'd like to edit or delete a saved link, and clicking one should take me to the actual page.

Longer term I'd also love things like saving a note on a link, keeping a saved copy of the page in case it disappears, and tidying up old ones by archiving instead of deleting. But the core of it is: save a link fast, tag it, and find it again later.
